## 📋 Checklist

**Before Submitting:**
- [ ] Searched existing issues (no duplicate)
- [ ] Feature aligns with 5D Framework mission
- [ ] Considered alternatives (is there a simpler solution?)

**For Maintainers (if accepted):**
- [ ] Discuss technical approach
- [ ] Create implementation plan
- [ ] Add to TODO.md or TODO_MULTIPAGE.md
- [ ] Implement feature
- [ ] Add tests
- [ ] Update documentation
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated
